Get hooked by this brand-new, addictive thriller full of jaw-dropping twists and dark secrets.

'A rollercoaster ride that I couldn’t put down … I still needed to look over my shoulder even after checking that I’d locked all of my windows and doors' FIVE STAR Reader Review

'Wow. A five-star, edge-of-your-seat masterpiece … I was left stunned' FIVE STAR Reader Review

'Suspenseful, jaw-dropping … I devoured this book in one sitting' FIVE STAR Reader Review

* * * * *

Who is watching Nell Masters?

Nell Masters is certain she’s being watched. Every day she feels a prickling unease on her morning commute, silent phone calls echo in her office, and an extravagant bouquet arrives at her doorstep – no card, no clue.

But Nell has reason to look over her shoulder. Because Nell has a secret…

Fourteen years ago, Nell witnessed a young woman get into a stranger’s car. When that woman was later found murdered, Nell became obsessed with finding the killer – a fixation that led her down a dangerous path. But has the hunter become the hunted? Or is there something even more deadly at play?

Bestselling author B A Paris returns with a blistering thriller about secrets, identity and the shadows that haunt us, perfect for fans of The Family Friend and His and Hers.

* * * * *

Praise for B A Paris:

'A mesmeric, tense and twisting nightmare. Suffocating, controlled and hugely entertaining' Chris Whitaker

‘The challenge is to separate dangerous reality from paranoia in this unsettling, pulse-racing tale’ Louise Candlish

'Expertly plotted and compellingly told … I raced through it' Harriet Tyce

'A rollercoaster ride, with plenty of twists' Observer

'B A Paris is a mistress at weaving family with fear, suspense and subterfuge' Jane Corry

‘A powerful, beautifully crafted story that ratchets up the tension with every page and packs a huge emotional punch’ T. M. Logan

'Packed with tension and nail-bitingly real, I couldn't put it down!' Lauren North

'B A Paris is a master storyteller, and WHEN I KILL YOU is a nerve-jangling rollercoaster of a thriller: pacey, twisty and propulsive' J P Delaney

* * * * *

Readers give WHEN I KILL YOU five stars!

'Dark, twisty and psychologically sharp, this was a real page-turner'

'A tense, gripping thriller that’s easy to get into and hard to put down'

'Kept me up all night … I couldn't put it down'

'A totally unpredictable rollercoaster'

'I was hooked from the start and couldn't function until I got to the end!'

'Full of twists and so well-written … B A Paris is a fabulous author but this is one of the best'

'Creepy, suspenseful, addictive'

About the author

B A PARIS is the New York Times and Sunday Times international bestselling author of Behind Closed Doors, The Breakdown, Bring Me Back, The Dilemma, The Therapist, The Prisoner, and The Guest. Having lived in France for many years, she and her husband now live in the UK.
